evidence.detail: Open feature request: add per-card historical trend display (e.g. 'played since S5, got good in S10') on /seasons/all/cards/{name}
No existing per-card cross-season historical trend query or view found in current master
wilson_lower_bound_sql() exists and is used for archetype sorting but not for card-level cross-season trend display

triage.notes: A comment on the issue (2024-05-02) clarifies the feature is really about win-rate trajectory (Wilson lower bound) across seasons, not just num_decks. Requires new season-bucketed SQL query on card performance, a new view or template section on the card page, and UX decisions about how to surface the trend.
